title: Continuous Infusions vs Scheduled Bolus Infusions
official: A Prospective Comparison of Pain and Analgesia in Patients With Continuous Peripheral Nerve Block Catheters Using Continuous Infusion or Scheduled Bolus Infusion
summary: The goal of the study is to compare continuous infusions and scheduled bolus infusions for peripheral nerve blocks and their effect on post-surgical pain.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients presenting for nerve block catheters for post-operative analgesia
* ASA physical status I, II, or III.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Incarceration
* Age \<18
* BMI \>35
* Pre-operative opioid use \>30 mg morphine equivalents per day
* Inability to communicate with investigators by telephone
* Pre-existing neuropathy of the operative extremity.
